name: mul_div_token
formula: d = 1 if token==0 else 10^k; a*b fits u64: (1, floor(a*b/d)); else checked floor(a/d)*b

name: ratio_round
formula: q = floor or ceil (flag) of a*10^k/b in u128; rax = q fits u64, rdx = low q

name: ratio_ceil
formula: q = ceil(a*10^k/b) in u128; rax = q, or 0 if q > u64::MAX

name: ntl_ratio_capped
formula: q = floor or ceil (flag) of a*b/(100*10^k) in u128; rax = q < 0x28f5c28f5c28f5c, rdx = low q

name: mul_div_reorder
formula: d = 10^k of the pair quote token; a*b fits: floor(a*b/d); else a%d==0: (a/d)*b; b%d==0: (b/d)*a; else (max/d)*min; 0 if that overflows

name: max_sz_for_px
formula: rax = min(floor(10^18/b), floor(a/10^k)) with k of the pair base token

name: side_amount
formula: flag: (quote token, checked a*b); else (base token, checked b*10^k)

name: mul_div_floor_one
formula: b==0: 0; a*10^k fits: q=floor(a*10^k/b); else q=checked floor(a/b)*10^k or 0; q==0 becomes 1

name: order_notional
formula: q = min(floor(10^18/b), floor(a/10^k)); n = b*q; error store if n overflows or n > i64::MAX-1
